lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr₂Zn crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms—four Sr and two Zn—distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both sites: each Sr center has 12 geometric neighbors (8 Sr, 4 Zn), while each Zn center has 12 Sr neighbors, with distances near 3.48–3.53 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Sr and Zn coordination polyhedra.
